Card Q&A.a: No, this card's effect does not allow ignoring digivolution requirements, so you can only digivolve into a card that meets the digivolution requirements.
Card Q&A.q: When I use this card's [All Turns] effect to digivolve into [Fenriloogamon] in my trash, can it digivolve regardless of its digivolution requirements?

Effect: [When Digivolving] By trashing 2 cards in your hand, delete 1 of your opponent's 6000 DP or lower Digimon. If this effect didn't delete, you may play 1 level 4 or lower [SoC] trait Digimon card from your trash without paying the cost.

[All Turns] When one of your other [SoC] trait Digimon is deleted, this Digimon with an [SoC] trait Tamer card in its digivolution cards may digivolve into [Fenriloogamon] in the trash without paying the cost.
Inherited Effect: [End of Attack] [Once Per Turn] If your opponent has 1 or more memory, unsuspend this Digimon.
